groups.shot_profile: Shot-location counts from play-by-play. Unlocks the Rim Pressure dimension and the shot-profile model features.

note: Frozen DraftLens estimators and peer references, serialised for browser-local inference on user-imported datasets. Contains no draft outcome, no pick, and no training rows.

coverage.component_available_if: the metric is non-null AND any declared reliability minimum is met
coverage.custom_rule: A custom Fit Score is returned only when at least half of the requested weight lands on dimensions that could be scored. Otherwise the score is UNAVAILABLE rather than manufactured.
coverage.data_coverage_is_separate: data_coverage is reported alongside the Fit Score and NEVER multiplies, penalises or rewards it. A prospect must not score higher merely because more data exists for them.
coverage.dimension_rule: A dimension is scored when at least half its components (rounded up) are available; it renormalises over the available ones. Otherwise the dimension is UNAVAILABLE — never zero, never 50.
coverage.missing_is_never_zero: Filling a missing component with 0 would make missingness a signal. Missing-data rows were disproportionately undrafted historically, so this would smuggle the outcome back in.

customMode.formula: fit_raw = sum(w_i * d_i) / sum(w_i) over REQUESTED dimensions that are AVAILABLE for that prospect
customMode.optional_note: RIM_PRESSURE is scored and available to the engine but is not one of PRODUCT.md §7.2's approved custom sliders. Adding it to the custom UI requires a product decision.

BOX_SCORE_DEFENSIVE_PRODUCTION.MANDATORY_LABEL: This measures BOX-SCORE DEFENSIVE PRODUCTION, never defensive quality. There is no matchup data, no opponent shooting when defended, no on/off context and no deterrence measure (ML_SPEC §18.3).

excluded.drb_pct: belongs to REBOUNDING; including it in both dimensions would double-count it whenever a user weights Defence and Rebounding together
excluded.personal_fouls_per_40: not defensibly directional — a high foul rate can mean aggression or poor discipline, and nothing in the data separates them

BOX_SCORE_DEFENSIVE_PRODUCTION.label: Box-score defensive production
BOX_SCORE_DEFENSIVE_PRODUCTION.rationale: Blocks and steals are strongly position-dependent (PRODUCT.md §8). Position-relative asks the answerable question: does this prospect generate defensive events at a high rate FOR THEIR POSITION?

excluded.assist_to_turnover_ratio: literally the ratio of the two components already present — pure double counting
excluded.assists_per_40: same signal as ast_pct on a different denominator
excluded.usage_pct: measures role and shot volume, not playmaking

PLAYMAKING.label: Playmaking
PLAYMAKING.rationale: A team asking for a playmaker wants absolute creation, not 'good for a centre'.

excluded.trb_pct: a deterministic composite of the two components already present — including it triple-counts the same rebounds

REBOUNDING.label: Rebounding
REBOUNDING.rationale: Six rebounds means something different for a guard and a centre — the canonical example in PRODUCT.md §8.

RIM_PRESSURE.MANDATORY_LABEL: Rim pressure is a shot-diet and finishing profile. It is NOT an athleticism measure and must never be presented as one.

excluded.dunk_make_pct / tip_make_pct: sparse rare-event ratios whose definedness is target-correlated (DEC-073, DEC-076)
excluded.layup_attempt_share / dunk_attempt_share: these SUM to rim_attempt_share exactly (ML-4 verified max deviation 0.0000000000); including them alongside it double-counts the same attempts

RIM_PRESSURE.label: Rim pressure
RIM_PRESSURE.rationale: A rim-oriented scoring style is absolute, not position-relative. This dimension describes SHOT DIET AND FINISHING — it is explicitly NOT athleticism.

excluded.jump_shot_*: hoopR jump-shot subcategories break schema at 2020/21 and are not comparable across the window (DEC-068)
excluded.ts_pct: |r| = 0.939 with efg_pct (ML-4 §6) and includes free throws, which would double-count ft_pct

SHOOTING.label: Shooting
SHOOTING.rationale: Shooting means the same thing at every position — a big who shoots like a guard is valuable BECAUSE of that. Position-relative normalisation would erase exactly the signal the Stretch Big profile needs.

excluded.standing_reach: NOT IN THE DATA. Never fabricated.
excluded.wingspan: NOT IN THE DATA. Never fabricated.

SIZE.label: Size
SIZE.rationale: Absolute size is what 'size' means. Position-relative normalisation would place every centre near the 50th percentile and destroy the signal the Rim Protector and Stretch Big profiles depend on. Position-relative size is computed for the sensitivity analysis only.

PLAYMAKER.label: Playmaker
PLAYMAKER.rationale: Creation volume and ball security, equally weighted. Volume is inherent in ast_pct, so no extreme low-usage assist ratio can manufacture an elite score.

RIM_PROTECTOR.label: Rim protector
RIM_PROTECTOR.rationale: Conjunctive across blocking, defensive glass and size. Shot blocking uses the GLOBAL reference here, not position-relative — otherwise a 6-foot guard with a good-for-guards block rate would read as elite rim protection.

SHOOTER.label: Shooter
SHOOTER.rationale: Conjunctive on purpose. 3P% alone crowns a low-volume specialist; volume alone crowns an inefficient chucker. A geometric mean requires BOTH.

SLASHER.label: Slasher / Rim attacker
SLASHER.rationale: The rim-pressure dimension already combines shot diet, contact drawing, finishing and self-creation with equal weight. No profile-specific complement improves it.

STRETCH_BIG.label: Stretch big
STRETCH_BIG.rationale: Must genuinely combine big-man size AND perimeter shooting. A geometric mean prevents a small guard winning on shooting alone; SIZE uses the GLOBAL reference so absolute size still carries meaning.

THREE_AND_D.label: 3&D Wing
THREE_AND_D.naming_caveat: '3&D Wing' is an archetype name, not evidence of a true NBA wing position. Only the coarse G/F distinction is leakage-safe; SG vs SF cannot be inferred.
THREE_AND_D.rationale: Inherently conjunctive: a prospect elite at only one side is not a 3&D wing. Arithmetic mean would allow full compensation.

reliabilityMinimums.note: A rate computed from a handful of attempts is noise. Below these denominators the component is MISSING, not zero, and its dimension renormalises over what remains.
